Name: MisoMegu's Mulberry Tree
Author: MisoMegu
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8y7g2vt.png[/img]
[size=4]─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───[/size]

[size=4]As a kid my friends and I had this massive mulberry tree in the creek we hung out at everyday and its berries were our favorite snack. So feeling nostalgic, I made this mod! [/size]

[size=4]It's really nothing fancy but I tested it and it works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049?tab=description]Wildflour's Artisan Machines[/url] so it could be a new tasty berry treat to grow and make into goods! I hope people who have had mulberries enjoy this mod and for people who don't know what they are, do your research before you go foraging for wild food![/size]

[size=4]Made for 1.6[/size]
[size=4]Needs [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=4]Content Patcher[/size][/url][size=4]﻿[/size]
[size=4]As always, I am open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else![/size]
[size=4]I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission![/size]

[size=4]If you enjoy my mods please endorse and track them and [/size][url=https://paypal.me/FuKitsuneKyo?country.x=US&locale.x=en_US][size=4]donate[/size][/url][size=4]﻿ if you have some spare change ♥[/size]
